question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bear the brunt
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Suffer the worst of something'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Bear the brunt'** is** 'Suffer the worst of something'.**
 
• **Bear the brunt:** To suffer the worst part of an unpleasant or problematic situation. (किसी अप्रिय या समस्याग्रस्त स्थिति का सबसे बुरा हिस्सा भुगतना)
 
 
• *Example: The driver **bore the brunt of** the crash because he was right at the front of the bus.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Suffer the worst of something.*
